question: In Battle Nations, how many units require the Barracks (any level) to be trained, according to the wiki?
answer:
I couldn't get a reliable count. The Battle Nations wiki blocked my direct fetches (HTTP 402), and the shell and grep tools were disabled, so I couldn't check your local `battlenations.yaml`.

Search results from the wiki showed at least 10 Barracks units: Grenadier, Shock Trooper, Arsonist, Mortar Team, Ranger, Saboteur, Armadillo, Bazooka Squad, Demolitionist and Commando. That is only a partial list, so 10 is a lower bound, not the answer.

If you enable shell or file-read access, I can count the units from `battlenations.yaml`.

Sources: [Commando](https://battlenations.fandom.com/wiki/Commando), [Ranger](https://battlenations.fandom.com/wiki/Ranger), [Grenadier](https://battlenations.fandom.com/wiki/Grenadier), [Saboteur](https://battlenations.fandom.com/wiki/Saboteur)
reason: The candidate says it couldn't get a reliable count and gives only a lower bound of 10, which is far outside the 55–67 partial range and does not match the expected 61.
